hero.title: Your own container. Your own space.
hero.subtitle: Rent your own lockable storage container on our guarded site! We offer a secure place for your valuables, with flexible access and simple rental.

features.title: Why people choose Méta Konténer
features.subtitle: A simple, secure way to store what doesn't fit at home.

items.title: Secure site
items.description: Fenced, monitored grounds with cameras and lighting, so your belongings stay safe day and night.

items.title: Flexible rental
items.description: Rent for a month or a year. Scale up or down as your storage needs change, with no long contracts.

items.title: Easy access
items.description: Drop by and pick up your things whenever the site is open — no appointment, no waiting on staff.

items.title: Weatherproof
items.description: Steel containers keep your items dry and protected from rain, frost, and summer heat all year round.

items.title: Any size load
items.description: From a few boxes to furniture and equipment — pick the container size that fits what you're storing.

items.title: Fair pricing
items.description: Transparent monthly pricing with no hidden fees. Pay for the space you actually use.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Renting a container takes three simple steps.

steps.title: Choose your container
steps.description: Tell us how much space you need and pick the container size that fits.

steps.title: Sign and move in
steps.description: Sign a simple rental agreement and get your own key and site access.

steps.title: Store with confidence
steps.description: Bring your belongings whenever you like — your container, your schedule.
